about_the_game:
Stick and Stack adds a deep new layer of challenge to the tried and true block stacking, line clearing, action puzzler game-play formula. Pieces wont just slide past each other, as soon as they come into contact they'll stick in place!

Make use of seeds which grow vines into hard to reach gaps and powder bombs which can smooth over the stickiness of a small section of your stack to overcome this new sticky situation. But you'll still need to learn a whole new way to stack your way to victory!

Play any one of three modes that suit different lengths of play, with a complete set of handcrafted difficulty levels for each mode that provide the perfect level of challenge for anyone from a complete beginner to the best of the best.

Game Features:

  • Instantly familiar gameplay that anyone can jump right into, but with a fresh twist that changes everything.
  • Score-based game-play with specific targets to aim for.
  • Multiple, handcrafted difficulty levels across 3 different gameplay modes to provide a fair challenge regardless of skill.
  • Tetrominos.
  • Three different kinds of vine-growing seeds add unique strategy and game-play variety with unique effects that range from helpful to hazardous.
  • Powder bombs are a limited resource to paint tiles white and remove their stickiness, vital for using at critical points to make the most out of the pieces you have.
  • Relaxing hand-crafted nature themed pixel art visuals.
  • A unique, upbeat soundtrack with three different tracks to enjoy while playing or just chilling on the menu.
  • Responsive yet forgiving controls optimized to give you the best chance at getting that piece exactly where you want.
  • Robust set of movement, rotation, kicking, and sticking mechanics designed from the ground up for Stick and Stack that open up a whole new world of advanced maneuvers to make the most out of even the stickiest situations.
  • Support for keyboard or controller input with fully customizable bindings.
  • An anything-goes Custom Game mode where nearly every aspect of the game can be adjusted and tweaked for endless varieties of challenges, silly fun, or anything else you can think up.

short_description: A fresh twist on the familiar block stacking formula where every piece sticks immediately on contact! Master the challenge of arranging tetrominos and strategically growing vines to fill gaps as the pace grows increasingly frantic in this sticky, nature-themed puzzler.
